examples: Ask which computer would take a browser test run right now, and read how many cores and gigabytes each one has free after the share it keeps for its owner.
Let a busy daytime computer send a heavy build to the idle one, while a small job stays on the computer its project lives on.
See a spawn that no computer could take wait in the queue with the reason, and cancel it.
how_to: Ask an agent to call placement_explain with a workload kind (light, browser, suite, build or render) to see the decision and every computer's headroom.
Turn auto-distribute on in the Pack settings (the alpha holds it) to spread light work too; pick the model for enhanced placement under byoai routing as the pack placement feature.
Tag a swarm_spawn with a workload (kind and size estimates); without one the task type picks a default.
Open a Swarm agent's chat: when the pack placed it, a quiet line under the title strip says placed on <computer>: <reason>. An agent the pack did not place shows no line.
media_exempt: Routes and agent tools only in this slice; the settings screen for it ships with the Pack settings UI slice.
name: Pack placement
summary: a new agent goes to the computer with room left after the share its owner keeps free; light work stays on its project's home, battery blocks heavy work, a full Pack queues the request, and a computer over its line puts its own agents in the background priority.
where: Agent tools (placement_explain, pack_queue_items_list, pack_queue_cancel) and the Pack API; the pack placement feature in byoai routing.
